name: 35 - API - Generate Post Visit Followups - Standalone Final

nodes.name: Normalize and Validate Post Visit Generation

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS followup_stage,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST($3::INTEGER, 0),
            2160
        ) AS visit_end_min_hours_ago,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST($4::INTEGER, 1),
            2160
        ) AS visit_end_max_hours_ago,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST($5::INTEGER, 1),
            168
        ) AS response_deadline_hours,

        $6::TEXT AS channel,

        LEAST(
            GREATEST($7::INTEGER, 1),
            500
        ) AS result_limit
),

expired_followups AS (
    UPDATE appointment_post_visit_followups followup

    SET
        status = 'expired',
        updated_at = NOW()

    WHERE followup.status = 'pending'
      AND followup.expires_at <= NOW()

    RETURNING followup.id
),

expiry_barrier AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS expired_count
    FROM expired_followups
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,

        request.followup_stage,
        request.visit_end_min_hours_ago,
        request.visit_end_max_hours_ago,
        request.response_deadline_hours,
        request.channel,
        request.result_limit

    FROM request_data request

    CROSS JOIN expiry_barrier barrier

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE

    ORDER BY clinic.id
    LIMIT 1
),

eligible_appointments AS (
    SELECT
        appointment.id AS appointment_id,
        appointment.clinic_id,
        appointment.doctor_id,
        appointment.patient_id,
        appointment.service_id,
        appointment.starts_at,
        appointment.ends_at,
        appointment.status AS appointment_status,

        clinic.clinic_name,
        clinic.timezone,
        clinic.followup_stage,
        clinic.response_deadline_hours,
        clinic.channel,

        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile,

        doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,
        service.name AS service_name

    FROM appointments appointment

    INNER JOIN clinic_context clinic
        ON clinic.clinic_id = appointment.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.id = appointment.patient_id

    INNER JOIN doctors doctor
        ON doctor.id = appointment.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services service
        ON service.id = appointment.service_id

    WHERE appointment.status = 'confirmed'

      AND appointment.ends_at <=
            NOW()
            - MAKE_INTERVAL(
                hours => clinic.visit_end_min_hours_ago
            )

      AND appointment.ends_at >
            NOW()
            - MAKE_INTERVAL(
                hours => clinic.visit_end_max_hours_ago
            )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointment_post_visit_followups existing

          WHERE existing.appointment_id =
                appointment.id

            AND existing.followup_stage =
                clinic.followup_stage
      )

    ORDER BY appointment.ends_at, appointment.id

    LIMIT (
        SELECT result_limit
        FROM clinic_context
    )
),

inserted_followups AS (
    INSERT INTO appointment_post_visit_followups (
        appointment_id,
        followup_stage,
        followup_token,
        status,
        channel,
        request_created_at,
        expires_at
    )

    SELECT
        eligible.appointment_id,
        eligible.followup_stage,

        MD5(
            RANDOM()::TEXT
            || CLOCK_TIMESTAMP()::TEXT
            || eligible.appointment_id::TEXT
            || eligible.followup_stage
        ),

        'pending',
        eligible.channel,
        NOW(),

        NOW()
        + MAKE_INTERVAL(
            hours =>
                eligible.response_deadline_hours
        )

    FROM eligible_appointments eligible

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id AS followup_id,
        appointment_id,
        followup_stage,
        followup_token,
        status AS followup_status,
        channel,
        request_created_at,
        expires_at
),

followup_details AS (
    SELECT
        followup.followup_id,
        followup.followup_stage,
        followup.followup_token,
        followup.followup_status,
        followup.channel,
        followup.expires_at,

        eligible.appointment_id,
        eligible.patient_name,
        eligible.mobile,
        eligible.doctor_name,
        eligible.service_name,
        eligible.timezone,
        eligible.starts_at,
        eligible.ends_at

    FROM inserted_followups followup

    INNER JOIN eligible_appointments eligible
        ON eligible.appointment_id =
           followup.appointment_id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM followup_details
        )
            THEN 'no_post_visit_followups_needed'

        ELSE 'post_visit_followups_created'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'کلینیک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM followup_details
        )
            THEN 'در بازه انتخاب‌شده مراجعه‌ای برای ایجاد پیگیری جدید وجود ندارد.'

        ELSE 'درخواست‌های پیگیری پس از مراجعه آماده ارسال شدند.'
    END AS message,

    request.clinic_name,
    request.followup_stage,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM followup_details
    ) AS followup_count,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'followup_id',
                        followup_id,

                    'followup_stage',
                        followup_stage,

                    'followup_token',
                        followup_token,

                    'appointment_id',
                        appointment_id,

                    'patient_name',
                        patient_name,

                    'mobile',
                        mobile,

                    'doctor_name',
                        doctor_name,

                    'service_name',
                        service_name,

                    'appointment_date',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD'
                        ),

                    'appointment_start_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),

                    'visit_end_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            ends_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
                        ),

                    'channel',
                        channel,

                    'expires_at',
                        expires_at,

                    'next_action',
                        'send_post_visit_followup'
                )
                ORDER BY ends_at
            )
            FROM followup_details
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS followups

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## تولید پیگیری پس از مراجعه

1. ابتدا Workflow شماره 34 را یک‌بار اجرا کن.

2. Workflow به‌صورت دستی، Webhook یا ساعتی اجرا می‌شود.

3. فقط نوبت‌های confirmed که زمان مراجعه آن‌ها گذشته است بررسی می‌شوند.

4. برای هر نوبت و هر مرحله پیگیری فقط یک رکورد ساخته می‌شود.

5. خروجی برای اتصال به WhatsApp، SMS، تماس یا فرم وب آماده است.
